title: Matsuken Anime: Kore Seibaishite mo Ii desu ka?

alternative_titles.en: Matsuken Anime: Can I Pass Judgment on This?
alternative_titles.ja: マツケンアニメ~コレ成敗してもいいですか？～

synopsis:
The anime centers on the character Matsuken and his dog partner Matsu Inu, who cheerfully "vanquish" various hazy feelings or frustrations of the everyday modern life.

(Source: ANN)
